6c85628378.q: What are the three main signals that matter to AI for business recommendations?
6c85628378.a: The three signals are: one, location—name, address, phone number accuracy; two, reputation—what people say about you online and reviews on your Google Business page; and three, content—when people ask specific questions, ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI overviews pull information from business websites, so having helpful consumer information on your website is critical for being recommended.
